title: rosa canina var. dumetorum
intro: Rosa canina var. dumetorum, commonly known as the Dwarf Dog Rose, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is a variety of the Rosa canina species, known for its small size and thorny branches. The Dwarf Dog Rose has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina var. dumetorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
